prompt:
Photograph in late afternoon sun on the main deck of a 17th-century
Spanish galleon, looking aft from a little above. Across the back, the
raised quarterdeck with a carved wooden balustrade along its edge, a
wooden stair up to it at each side, and three plank doors with small
windows under it; behind and above, the mizzen mast, rigging and furled
sails against an orange and blue evening sky with clouds, and lanterns
on the stern. The deck in front, from the foot of the quarterdeck to
the bottom of the picture, is wide empty planking with ropes coiled at
its sides, open for two men to fight on. Nobody is on it. Historical
reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. Style: one consistent look for the whole series, photographed like a
period film still of the 1660s Caribbean, natural warm light, gentle
film grain, muted rich colours with warm amber and deep teal tones,
moderate contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, no text.
